prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1248; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has been advised to decline any recorded statements or settlement discussions until we have reviewed the file.

We request that you disclose the full liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved, including any excess or umbrella coverage, and that you confirm in writing the limits you have identified.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, witness statements, and any electronic data stored in your systems. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such material while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
